summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Smart Bharat AI-Powered Civic Companion. Backend APIs 100% functional (10/10 tests passed). Frontend 90% functional (9/10 tests passed). All core features working: service simplification with AI, chat streaming, issue reporting with vision analysis, tracking system, and bilingual support (English/Hindi).

ui_bugs.issue: Chat widget open button click intercepted by 'Made with Emergent' badge overlay at bottom-right corner
ui_bugs.workaround: Using force=True in click bypasses the issue. Z-index adjustment needed for badge.
